CMOS divide-by-two clock divider
.include "circuit.spice"
.include "models.spice"
VDD vdd 0 3.3
VCLK clk 0 PULSE(0 3.3 20n 100p 100p 19.9n 40n)
.ic v(q)=0
XDUT vdd 0 q clk astra_040_cmos_toggle_frequency_divider
.temp 27
.options method=gear reltol=1e-5
* @spec high1 range 3.2 3.4 unit=V
* @spec low1 range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
* @spec high2 range 3.2 3.4 unit=V
* @spec low2 range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
* @spec high3 range 3.2 3.4 unit=V
* @spec period range 7.9e-8 8.1e-8 unit=s
* @spec width range 3.9e-8 4.1e-8 unit=s
.control
set filetype=ascii
tran 20p 400n
meas tran high1 FIND v(q) AT=30n
meas tran low1 FIND v(q) AT=70n
meas tran high2 FIND v(q) AT=110n
meas tran low2 FIND v(q) AT=150n
meas tran high3 FIND v(q) AT=190n
meas tran period TRIG v(q) VAL=1.65 RISE=3 TARG v(q) VAL=1.65 RISE=4
meas tran width TRIG v(q) VAL=1.65 RISE=3 TARG v(q) VAL=1.65 FALL=3
write out.raw
quit
.endc
.end
